maria (sales_eng): Kickoff: Neobank POC next wk. Need a short internal onboarding checklist for provisioning: hosted API key, dedicated pool request (2x A100), VPC peering, and quick test steps. Who picks which items?

kevin (solutions): I can draft the checklist. Owners: sales_eng = hosted key + customer comms; infra = pool + peering; security = questionnaire + signoff.

liu (infra): Minimal infra steps: 1) fill pool form (model, gpu_type, pool_size, qps, region, duration). 2) collect customer account ID + CIDR (no overlap). 3) create peering + update routes. 4) add IP allowlist. Template YAML we accept: `model: gptj-13b-v1; pool_size: 2; gpu_type: a100-80gb; region: us-west-2; duration_weeks: 3; expected_qps: 10`

anya (security): I'll send the security questionnaire. Key items: is PII present, KMS/BYOK needs, SSO type (SAML/OIDC), audit log retention, and approved network contact.

maria (sales_eng): For hosted key: Console -> Projects -> fin-neobank-poc -> API Keys -> Create. Scopes: inference:generate, billing:view. Set max_tokens_per_min to 50k for tests.

kevin (solutions): Quick smoke tests to include in runbook: 1) basic curl with hosted key. 2) when pool ready, add header `X-Redwood-Pool: neobank-pool` and run 30 concurrent calls. 3) verify p95 latency and token cost. Fallback route: hosted fallback model if dedicated not ready.

maria (sales_eng): Action list: maria create hosted key + share to customer (today), liu complete infra request (today), anya send questionnaire (today), kevin add tests and cost placeholders to POC doc (EOD). I'll post updates here.
